battle.name: 居魯士大帝征服埃蘭
battle.brief: 公元前540年前後，波斯王居魯士二世以安山之王的名號率軍東南，攻入埃蘭國土，在首都薩西斯所在的胡齊斯坦低地與埃蘭王特烏曼的軍隊一戰而決，一役擒其君臣三首。波斯持盾重步兵以柳條大盾列成密集方陣前推，遠征行列中亦見希臘式的科林斯全覆面青銅盔。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 交戰的兩方是波斯（阿契美尼德王國）與埃蘭。波斯一方以安山與波斯之王居魯士二世為核心，發號施令與後勤中樞在薩西斯（波斯語 Šušâ），遠征的集結地在薩西斯與伊朗高原之間；軍隊分三層：中央直屬的持盾重步兵，每人配一張大柳條盾、長矛與青銅頭盔；無大盾的長矛兵與弓箭手；以及各屬地徵發的部隊，另有騎兵與四馬戰車隊負責機動突擊。波斯後勤靠御道與薩西斯的國有倉儲維持，亞述人行軍日程表裡記載的「埃蘭道路」山口與渡河點，後來被波斯人沿用。埃蘭一方是南伊朗的埃蘭王國，國王自稱「安山與薩西斯之王、埃蘭之地之王」，首都薩西斯兼作宗教中心，統治胡齊斯坦低地、卡倫河與克爾克黑河（亞述文獻中的烏萊河）流域，並在巴比倫南部保有埃蘭人散居的農業區。埃蘭軍隊以重裝步兵為骨幹：持長矛、盾高及身如鏟的柳條與皮製大盾兵列，頭戴青銅盔（有時加冠座），配劍與矛；埃蘭弓手在亞述與巴比倫的戰報裡名聲極盛，另有輕裝騎兵與每車三至四人的輕戰車隊。背景中的第三方是巴比倫：那波那尼德與埃蘭往來密切，曾把薩西斯的守護神像與財貨運往巴比倫；居魯士在攻巴比倫的前後都不得不把埃蘭計入戰略。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were Persia, the Achaemenid kingdom, and Elam. The Persian side was built around Cyrus II, king of Anshan and Persia, with the seat of government and the logistics centre at Susa (Old Persian Šušâ) and the concentration ground for the column lying between Susa and the Iranian plateau. The army had three layers: the personally held heavy infantry of the centre, the shield-bearers, each with a large wicker shield, a long spear and a bronze helmet; the spearmen without a large shield and the archers; and the contingents levied from the subject peoples, with cavalry and four-horse war chariots held back for shock. Persian logistics ran on the royal road and on the state granaries of Susa, and the mountain passes and river crossings that the Assyrians had written into their itineraries for the Road to Elam were taken over and reused by the Persians. Elam was a kingdom of southwestern Iran whose king styled himself king of Anshan and Susa, king of the land of Elam. Its capital Susa doubled as the religious centre; it ruled the Khuzestan lowland and the basins of the Karun and the Karkheh, the ancient Ulai of the Assyrian records, and it held an Elamite diaspora of farms in southern Babylonia. The Elamite army was built around heavy infantry: spearmen with tall shovel-shaped wicker and hide shields that covered the whole body, bronze helmets sometimes fitted with a crest-holder, swords and spears. Elamite archers enjoyed a formidable reputation in the Assyrian and Babylonian war reports, and there were light cavalry and light war chariots crewed by three or four men. The third party in the background was Babylonia: Nabonidus kept close relations with Elam and even carried the statue of Susa's guardian god and its treasure up to Babylon, so Cyrus had to take Elam into his calculations on both sides of the Babylonian campaign.
people: 居魯士二世是全場唯一有名字的主帥。安山出身的他祖父泰伊斯佩斯、父坎比西斯一世，先在公元前550年左右滅米底王阿斯提亞吉斯，取得米底與波斯高原的人力與馬匹，才轉向兩河。埃蘭方面的決策人物是國王特烏曼、其子坦馬里圖，以及姻親兼統帥烏馬尼什；克西提亞斯記載三人同在一場會戰中率軍，並全部被俘。特烏曼這名字在亞述銘文裡也出現過，指的是公元前656至647年間反叛亞述的那位君主，但兩者在年代上難以相容，多數學者認為是同名先後兩人。薩西斯出土的坦馬里圖紀念碑記他為特烏曼之子，約公元前521年在巴比倫反叛達里士一世，被十字釘在木柱上，這說明埃蘭舊王族的血脈在前539年前後仍然延續。克西提亞斯筆下成為居魯士妻子的埃蘭公主潘忒亞，是戰後安排埃蘭的關鍵人物。史料層次上，希臘醫生克西提亞斯（尼多斯人，亞爾達薛西斯一世的御醫）的《波斯史》是本役唯一有細節的敘述；希羅多德《歷史》只把薩西斯與埃蘭列入居魯士的征服清單，語焉不詳；巴比倫的《巴比倫編年史》《居魯士編年史》與薩西斯出土的埃蘭泥板，則提供了非希臘的對照。
peopleEn: Cyrus II is the only commander on the Persian side who is named at all. The Anshan-born king, grandson of Teispes and son of Cambyses I, first destroyed the Median king Astyages around 550 BC, gaining the manpower and horses of Media and of the Iranian plateau, and only then turned towards Mesopotamia. On the Elamite side the decision-makers were the king Teumman, his son Tammaritu, and the brother-in-law who served as field commander, Ummanish. Ctesias has all three leading the army in a single battle and all three taken prisoner. The name Teumman also occurs in Assyrian inscriptions, where it belongs to the rebel of 656 to 647 BC, but the two cannot be reconciled chronologically, and most scholars treat them as two men of the same name. A stele of Tammaritu excavated at Susa calls him the son of Teumman and records his revolt against Darius I in Babylon around 521 BC, when he was crucified on a wooden stake, which shows that the line of the old Elamite royal house was still alive around 539 BC. Panthea, the Elamite princess who became the wife of Cyrus in Ctesias, is the key person in the settlement of Elam afterwards. As for the layers of source, the Greek physician Ctesias of Cnidus, doctor to Artaxerxes I, wrote the only detailed narrative of the campaign in his Persica. Herodotus merely lists Susa and Elam among Cyrus's conquests and says little more. The Babylonian Chronicle, the Cyrus Chronicle and the Elamite tablets from Susa provide the non-Greek comparison.
kits: 卡面是科林斯青銅盔（Corinthian helmet，約公元前650年）：全覆面的青銅殼，只留兩條窄眼縫與一道鼻脊，產地以科林斯最有名，雅典與安納托利亞的烏拉爾圖一帶也有仿製工坊，《伊利亞特》裡亞加美農與阿基里斯戴的正是這一型。它在居魯士的埃蘭戰役裡不會是制式裝備：波斯王室的頭盔自有亞述—波斯傳統的高冠一路，後來在御道石刻上出現的阿契美尼德「薩西斯型」盔（帶鉸接頰甲）反而承襲科林斯—阿提卡一系。但科林斯盔並非與此役無關：希臘與愛奧尼亞人自六世紀末起已為波斯效力，希羅多德記載岡比西斯二世進軍埃及時軍中已有愛奧尼亞與卡里亞雇兵；安納托利亞行省的希臘工匠供應甲胄，這些都把全覆面盔帶進波斯軍營。同場真正上手的另外兩套裝備才是主戰裝備：波斯持盾者用大張柳條盾（spadion），另配皮製小盾（tkyr）與柳條筐，兵器是長矛、彎刀 akinakes、斧 sagaris 與弓；埃蘭步兵的盾高及身如鏟，能把整個身體遮住，頭上是留冠座的青銅盔，配矛、劍與弓，另有每車三至四人的輕戰車。攻城器械沒有發揮空間，薩西斯是平原上的土築城，圍城靠斷糧與封鎖河道；運輸靠牛車隊與駱駝隊。
kitsEn: The card shows a Corinthian helmet of about 650 BC: a full-face bronze shell with only two narrow eye slits and a nasal ridge, best known from Corinth but copied by workshops at Athens and in Urartu in Anatolia, the very type worn by Agamemnon and Achilles in the Iliad. It would not have been issue equipment in Cyrus's Elamite campaign. The Persian royal helmet followed an Assyrian-Persian line with a high crown, and the Achaemenid Susa-type helmet with hinged cheek pieces that later appears on the reliefs of the royal terrace descends instead from the Corinthian-Attic line. Even so, the Corinthian helmet was not irrelevant to the campaign. Greeks and Ionians had been serving Persia since the close of the sixth century BC, and Herodotus notes Ionian and Carian mercenaries in the army of Cambyses II in Egypt; Greek armourers in the Anatolian satrapies supplied headgear and body armour, and all of this carried the full-face shell into the Persian camp. The two sets of equipment that really went into battle were quite different. The Persian shield-bearers carried a large wicker shield, the spadion, together with a small rawhide buckler, the tkyr, and a wicker basket, and were armed with spear, the akinakes short sword, the sagaris axe and the bow. Elamite infantry carried shovel-shaped shields so tall that they covered the whole body, bronze helmets fitted with crest-holders, spear, sword and bow, with light war chariots crewed by three or four men alongside. Siegecraft had no part to play: Susa was an unfortified mud-brick city standing on the plain, and a siege was a matter of cutting supply and closing the river. Transport was by ox-cart trains and camel caravans.
tactics: 克西提亞斯只說埃蘭人排成戰列、波斯人一戰而勝，具體過程要靠亞述人的作戰習慣去補。遠征埃蘭最要緊的是季節與路線：胡齊斯坦低地夏季酷熱，亞述君主寧可避開盛夏，也避開克爾克黑河的汛期，前655年與前604年的洪水都直接改寫過戰局。進軍有兩條路線：一是沿底格里斯東南折、穿過埃蘭北緣的山口；二是沿平原順河而下，路程較短但雨季易淹。會戰本身，埃蘭把大盾長矛步兵與弓手混編在一起，盾陣一旦被弓兵牽制，或被騎兵從側後擦到，就難以重整；波斯則以持盾者列成密集方陣，前排長矛構成壁壘，弓箭手自方陣兩側覆蓋射擊，戰車與騎兵待機破陣。科林斯盔正說明這一點：全覆面殼把視野壓到兩條窄縫，戴盔者幾乎不能獨自作戰，只能靠身旁同袍的節奏與方陣的整體推進；反觀波斯的大柳條盾，視線開闊，還能用盾緣支在地上撐住身體，在長途行軍與僵持中更耐撐。埃蘭的敗因還在於遠征方的補給線長、首領集中，一旦國王、王子與統帥同時被俘，軍隊當場就失去了指揮。
tacticsEn: Ctesias says only that the Elamites drew up their battle line and that the Persians won in a single day, so the procedure has to be reconstructed from Assyrian practice. The decisive factors in a campaign against Elam were the season and the route. The Khuzestan lowland is fiercely hot in summer, and the Assyrian kings avoided high summer and the flood season of the Karkheh; the floods of 655 and 604 BC each changed the course of a war. There were two approaches: south-east along the Tigris and through the passes on the northern rim of Elam, or straight down the plain following the river, the shorter road but the one that floods in the rains. In the battle itself, Elam mixed shield-bearing spearmen with archers; once the shield wall was pulled by the archers, or brushed by cavalry on the flank, the line could not be re-formed. Persia advanced the shield-bearers in a dense formation whose front rank of long spears made a barrier, with archers covering the flanks and the chariots and cavalry waiting to break the enemy. The Corinthian helmet makes the point: a full-face shell reduces vision to two slits, and the man wearing it cannot fight alone, only in the rhythm of the men beside him and the push of the formation. The Persian wicker shield, by contrast, leaves the eyes free and can be braced on its rim to support the body, which wears better on a long march and in a stalemate. Elam's defeat lay also in the length of its supply line and in the concentration of its leaders; once king, prince and commander were all captured at the same moment, the army lost its command on the spot.
data: 可核的數字不多，這本身就是重點。年份：本卡取公元前540年，學界有兩種排序——先埃蘭後巴比倫（約前540年），或先於公元前539年10月入巴比倫、再於前538年攻埃蘭。會戰：克西提亞斯記載為一場決定性交戰，波斯全勝。俘虜：三名埃蘭首領被俘，即特烏曼、坦馬里圖、烏馬尼什。兵力：希臘與楔形文字史料都沒有留下居魯士攻埃蘭的可靠數目，希臘人慣以萬計，後人引用的數字多屬推估。距離：薩西斯至巴比倫約一千一百至一千二百公里；希羅多德5.52說薩西斯至薩迪斯的御道全程一百一十一日，約二千七百公里，而埃蘭之戰正發生在這條御道的東端。地理：胡齊斯坦低地南北長約一百五十公里、東西約一百公里，薩西斯海拔約三十公尺，克爾克黑河與卡倫河兩大水系橫貫其間。前例數字：亞述於前585年在烏萊河擊敗埃蘭，前655至647年再度征埃蘭並劫掠薩西斯，前604年的洪水淹浸薩西斯的埃蘭軍營；前612年埃蘭與米底、巴比倫聯軍攻陷九尼微。戰役延續多久無從得知，克西提亞斯沒有留下行軍日程表。
dataEn: Few numbers can be verified, and that is itself part of the point. Date: this card takes 540 BC, while scholarship has two orderings, Elam before Babylon at about 540 BC, or Babylon first, entered in October 539 BC, and Elam in 538 BC. The battle: Ctesias describes one decisive engagement, won outright by Persia. Prisoners: three Elamite leaders were taken, Teumman, Tammaritu and Ummanish. Numbers of men: neither the Greek nor the cuneiform sources leave a reliable figure for Cyrus's army in Elam; Greeks habitually reckoned in myriads, and the figures quoted later are estimates. Distances: Susa to Babylon is roughly eleven hundred to twelve hundred kilometres; Herodotus 5.52 gives the royal road from Susa to Sardis as a journey of a hundred and eleven days, some twenty-seven hundred kilometres, and the Elamite war was fought at the eastern end of that road. Geography: the Khuzestan lowland runs about a hundred and fifty kilometres north to south and a hundred east to west, Susa stands some thirty metres above sea level, and two river systems, the Karkheh and the Karun, cross it. Precedents: Assyria beat Elam on the Ulai in 585 BC, campaigned against Elam again in 655 to 647 BC and sacked Susa, and in 604 BC a flood inundated the Elamite camp at Susa; in 612 BC a coalition of Elamites, Medes and Babylonians took Nineveh. How long the campaign lasted is unknown, for Ctesias leaves no marching timetable.
cause: 打得起來有四層原因。第一是權力真空：公元前612年九尼微陷落後，亞述的宗主權解體，埃蘭與波斯成了南部伊朗並立的兩強，而埃蘭的西部疆界正壓在波斯通往兩河的路徑上。第二是安山的故鄉問題：阿契美尼德王族的祖居安山就在埃蘭境內的高地，埃蘭王的銘文自稱「安山與薩西斯之王」，居魯士以安山王的名號出征，等於宣告對這片故土的宗主權。第三是對巴比倫的佈局：巴比倫與埃蘭往來密切，那波那尼德把薩西斯的守護神像與財貨運往巴比倫，居魯士要打巴比倫，就必須先解除埃蘭在其側翼的威脅，埃蘭之戰因此可看作征服巴比倫的先行手。第四是埃蘭自身的消耗：它被亞述打了數十年，前647年國都被劫、前604年大水淹營，國力未復，卻仍要支援遠在巴比倫的盟友與自身的防衛。戰略上，這也是打通御道東段、掌控伊朗西南水利的必要一步。
causeEn: There were four layers of reason. First, a vacuum of power: after Nineveh fell in 612 BC the Assyrian suzerainty dissolved, and Elam and Persia stood as the two powers of southern Iran, with Elam's western frontier pressed directly against the road Persia used to reach Mesopotamia. Second, the question of Anshan: the ancestral seat of the Achaemenid house lay at Anshan, in the highlands inside Elamite territory, and an Elamite inscription styles its king king of Anshan and Susa, so for Cyrus to march out as king of Anshan was to assert lordship over that homeland. Third, the deployment against Babylon: Babylonia and Elam were in close contact, Nabonidus carried the statue of Susa's guardian god and its treasure up to Babylon, and in order to strike Babylon Cyrus had first to remove the threat that Elam posed on his flank, so the Elamite war can be read as the opening move of the Babylonian conquest. Fourth, Elam's own exhaustion: worn down by Assyria for decades, its capital looted in 647 BC and its camp drowned in 604 BC, it still had to support its partner in Babylonia and its own defence. Strategically, the campaign was also the necessary step towards opening the eastern end of the royal road and taking control of the waterworks of south-western Iran.
impact: 埃蘭作為獨立的國家從此消失。薩西斯被納入波斯王室版圖，成為阿契美尼德四大王都之一，國王常駐此地處理西南方的土地與水利；埃蘭的國家機器沒有被拆毀，而是被整體接收——埃蘭書吏的計帳、倉儲與徭役制度，日後在御道沿線的行政裡仍看得到痕跡。宗教上亦如是：埃蘭的守護神伊奴舒希納克與納比沙的祭祀在薩西斯延續，後來與祗教諸神一同被帶入波斯波利斯。更大的長遠影響落在希臘人的想像：克西提亞斯的《波斯史》與色諾芬《居魯士傳說》把居魯士塑造成對待埃蘭俘虜寬厚、以三件好處自居的賢王；希臘雇兵與工匠在波斯的存在也從這類戰役開始累積，最終在公元前401年庫納克薩之役結合成有完整建制的希臘方陣雇兵部隊。對波斯自身而言，此役把御道東端與西南水利一次接通，帝國重心第一次明確落在伊朗本土，而不再只是兩河的下游。
impactEn: Elam ceased to exist as an independent state. Susa was folded into the royal dominions and became one of the four Achaemenid capitals, where the king dealt with the land and the waterworks of the south-west. The Elamite state machine was not dismantled but taken over wholesale: the scribes' accounting, the granaries and the labour service of Elam can still be traced in the administration along the royal road. Religion followed the same path, for the cults of Elam's guardian deities Inshushinak and Napirisha continued at Susa and were later carried to Persepolis alongside the gods of Zoroastrianism. The larger long-term effect fell on the Greek imagination: Ctesias's Persica and Xenophon's Cyropaedia turned Cyrus into the mild king who treats his Elamite captives well and who set down for himself three reasons for praise. The presence of Greek mercenaries and craftsmen in Persia began to accumulate through campaigns of this kind, until in 401 BC at Cunaxa it hardened into a Greek mercenary phalanx with a proper organisation. For Persia itself, the war opened the eastern end of the royal road and the waterworks of the south-west in a single stroke, and the centre of gravity of the empire for the first time lay firmly on the Iranian plateau rather than on the lower Euphrates.
result: 克西提亞斯的結論簡潔：埃蘭人一敗，三名首領特烏曼、坦馬里圖、烏馬尼什一併被俘，薩西斯落入波斯之手，埃蘭的國庫與土地成為居魯士的戰利品。戰後居魯士沒有做滅族滅國式的清洗，他與埃蘭公主潘忒亞成婚，替埃蘭維持舊有的祭祀與部分地方權力，把埃蘭變成波斯帝國南方的一個屬地，按年進貢。埃蘭作為獨立勢力的最後一次掙扎，要等到約公元前521年坦馬里圖在巴比倫起兵，隨即被達里士一世平定，坦馬里圖被十字釘在木柱上；此後埃蘭的國王頭銜只留在波斯王的自述與埃蘭舊貴族的石碑上。這場戰爭因此成為分水嶺：波斯得薩西斯與安山，埃蘭失國；此後波斯的南方邊界推到兩河最南端，而南伊朗的高原地區數百年不再出現獨立的埃蘭王權。
resultEn: Ctesias puts it briefly: the Elamites were beaten in a single day, the three leaders Teumman, Tammaritu and Ummanish were taken together, Susa fell into Persian hands, and the treasury and the land of Elam became Cyrus's booty. There was no ethnic cleansing after the war. Cyrus married the Elamite princess Panthea, preserved the old cults and part of the local authority, and turned Elam into a southern dependency of the Persian empire paying tribute by the year. Elam's last effort to act independently came around 521 BC, when Tammaritu rose in Babylon, was immediately put down by Darius I and was crucified on his wooden stake; after that the title of Elamite king survived only in the great king's own inscriptions and on the stelae of the old Elamite nobility. The war was therefore a watershed: Persia gained Susa and Anshan, Elam lost its country. From then on the southern frontier of Persia reached the southernmost edge of Mesopotamia, and the highlands of south-western Iran saw no independent Elamite kingship for centuries to come.
